svg.title: Plate III — The Skill: @classcad/skill
svg.desc: The API by domain, as a table of contents: part 76, assembly 63, sketch 50, common 22, curve 21, solid 21, drawing2d 11; 264 methods in all. And the six recipes: constrained sketching, verification, parametric parts, assembly parameters, pattern, then subtract, direct modelling.
